Thank you for the report. A question about how a model works is better sent to
steven.shafer@stanford.edu; see [SUPPORT.md](https://github.com/StevenLShafer/stanpumpR/blob/master/.github/SUPPORT.md).

This issue is public, and the app's URL carries every Patient Profile value (age, weight,
height, sex, genotypes) and the doses. If the simulation is of a real patient, change those
values to made-up ones that still show the problem before copying the URL, and include
nothing else about the patient.

**The simulation.** Paste the URL from the app's address bar. It carries the patient,
the doses, the events and the graph options. If it came from a teaching scenario, name
the scenario instead.

**What you expected.**

**What you saw instead.** A screenshot helps.

**Browser and device.** For example, Chrome on Windows, or Safari on an iPad.
